Confirm that the download comes from the official repository and verify the signature before installing.
For security, open and save existing automation tasks once after this update. Saved tasks receive a private authorization token. Tokens are not included in backups.
Downloading and verifying the update...
Update rejected or unavailable. The APK must match the installed package and signing certificate and have a newer version. Check network access and installation permissions.
The APK will be downloaded over HTTPS and checked against the installed signing certificate before opening the system installer. You must confirm installation. Shared files expire after 15 minutes.
Configuration storage unavailable

Your configuration could not be opened. The original files have been preserved, and proxy startup is paused. Retry after restoring the missing files, export the raw files for recovery, or archive them and start again.
Retry opening configuration
The configuration is still unavailable. If a reset was started, close and reopen the app before continuing it.
Export original files

This archive may contain plaintext proxy credentials and encrypted configuration files. Save it somewhere private. It is a recovery archive, not a normal backup; missing Android Keystore keys cannot be recreated from it.
Original files exported. Keep the recovery archive private.
Archive configuration and reset

The current files will be moved into a private recovery archive. New configuration will use a new key. The old files and key references will be preserved. The app will close; reopen it from the launcher to start again.
The operation could not be completed. Original files have not been deleted. Close and reopen the app before retrying a reset.
